home.heroLine2: Every Issue Has a Path to Action.
home.heroDesc: A secure, AI-assisted platform for citizens of Srikalahasti to report public-service issues — and for constituency staff to identify patterns, prioritize cases and coordinate responsible action.
home.howItWorksTitle: From Citizen Voice to Responsible Action
home.howItWorksSub: A transparent, predictable process for every submission.

submit.title: Report a Public Service Issue
submit.subtitle: Your submission is private. Name and contact are never required.
submit.descPlaceholder: Describe clearly: what happened, what was the expected outcome vs what occurred. Be factual and specific — include dates, locations and roles where possible.
submit.mobilePurpose: Your mobile number is collected only to send your Complaint ID, status updates and clarification requests. It will not be publicly displayed or used for advertising.
submit.consentLabel: I consent to receive complaint-related SMS or WhatsApp updates.
submit.anonymous: I want to submit confidentially (no contact stored)
submit.anonNote: When checked, no mobile number or email is stored. You can still track via Complaint ID.
submit.evidenceNote: Photos, videos, audio, documents. Max 10MB each. Do not upload Aadhaar, PAN, bank details or sensitive personal data unrelated to this complaint.
submit.successNote: Save your Complaint ID and tracking token — you will need them to track this complaint.

track.title: Complaint Status Tracker
track.subtitle: Enter your Complaint ID or Tracking Token to see the current status.
track.hint: Your Complaint ID starts with SKT- and was shown on the submission receipt.
track.notFound: No complaint found with this ID or token. Please check and try again.
track.privacyNote: Only safe status information is shown here. Mobile numbers, reviewer identities and internal notes are never displayed.
